result.topic_en: Variational formulation, differential equation and free-edge boundary conditions for the transverse vibrations of a rectangular elastic plate (Chladni figures, Kirchhoff-type theory).
result.transcription:
$\int dx\,dy \left[\frac{\theta}{1+2\theta}\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}\right)^2 + \frac{1+\theta}{1+2\theta}\left(\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}\right)^2+2\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y}\right)^2\right)\right] - \mu^4\int dx\,dy\, w^2 = M$[?]
$\frac{\partial^4 w}{\partial x^4}+2\frac{\partial^4 w}{\partial x^2\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^4 w}{\partial y^4} = \mu^4 w$ $\quad\mu^4 = \frac{12\,m^2(1+\theta)}{(a-b)\,\varepsilon^2(1+2\theta)}$[?]
$w_0 = w\cos(mt+C)$
$x=\pm a$ $\left|\; \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\theta}{1+2\theta}\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}=0\right.$
$\frac{\partial^3 w}{\partial x^3}+\frac{2+3\theta}{1+2\theta}\frac{\partial^3 w}{\partial x\partial y^2}=0$
$y=\pm b$ $\left|\; \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\theta}{1+2\theta}\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}=0\right.$
$\frac{\partial^3 w}{\partial y^3}+\frac{2+3\theta}{1+2\theta}\frac{\partial^3 w}{\partial x^2\partial y}=0$
$x=\pm a,\ y=\pm b$ $\left|\; \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y}=0\right.$
